about.approach.title: Acquisition, conversion and measurement should tell one story.
about.approach.body: DIAL is a Montenegro-based performance marketing consultancy built around hands-on experience in paid media, lead generation, web development, analytics and CRM. The approach is simple: attract relevant demand, make the path to enquiry clearer, track the meaningful steps and use lead quality — not platform metrics alone — to guide the next decision.
about.approach.items.1: 01 — Understand the commercial goal. Start with the market, audience, sales cycle, current data and the outcome the business actually needs.
about.approach.items.2: 02 — Build the acquisition path. Align channels, message, landing experience, conversion points and follow-up around the decisions a prospect needs to make.
about.approach.items.3: 03 — Measure what reaches the business. Connect campaign activity with enquiries, lead quality and CRM outcomes, then prioritise the next change based on evidence.

analyticsCrm.hero.title: See what happens between the click and the qualified lead.
analyticsCrm.hero.description: DIAL connects acquisition data, website behaviour, conversions and CRM outcomes so you can understand which channels generate enquiries, which leads are worth pursuing and where marketing budget should go next.
analyticsCrm.intro.title: Platform conversions are only the beginning.
analyticsCrm.intro.body1: Advertising platforms can tell you that a conversion happened. They cannot always tell you whether the enquiry was relevant, whether sales followed up, or whether the lead became a genuine commercial opportunity.
analyticsCrm.intro.body2: DIAL builds the measurement layer between campaigns, websites and CRM so reporting can move beyond clicks and form submissions toward the outcomes that matter to the business.
analyticsCrm.capabilities.title: From campaign source to CRM outcome.
analyticsCrm.capabilities.description: The measurement system should preserve useful context from the first interaction through enquiry and qualification without creating unnecessary reporting complexity.
analyticsCrm.capability.ga4.title: GA4 & Analytics
analyticsCrm.capability.ga4.description: Configure meaningful events, conversions and reporting around the actions that matter across the website rather than relying on page views alone.
analyticsCrm.capability.gtm.title: Google Tag Manager
analyticsCrm.capability.gtm.description: Implement and manage tracking logic through a structured tag-management layer that is easier to test, maintain and extend.
analyticsCrm.capability.conversion.title: Conversion Tracking
analyticsCrm.capability.conversion.descr: Track meaningful actions across Google Ads, Meta and the website so campaign optimisation is based on clearly defined conversion events.
analyticsCrm.capability.source.title: Source & Campaign Mapping
analyticsCrm.capability.source.descripti: Preserve campaign, source and medium information consistently so enquiries can be traced back to the marketing activity that generated them.
analyticsCrm.capability.crm.title: CRM Lead Architecture
analyticsCrm.capability.crm.description: Structure lead-source fields, campaign context, qualification and status so marketing data remains useful after an enquiry enters the sales process.
analyticsCrm.capability.quality.title: Lead Quality Feedback
analyticsCrm.capability.quality.descript: Use downstream qualification and CRM outcomes to understand which campaigns are producing relevant opportunities rather than simply the most leads.
analyticsCrm.capability.reporting.title: Reporting & Decision Support
analyticsCrm.capability.reporting.descri: Bring campaign, website and CRM signals into reporting that explains what changed, what is working and which decision deserves attention next.

analyticsCrm.outcome.source.title: Clearer source visibility

analyticsCrm.outcome.quality.title: Better lead-quality insight
analyticsCrm.outcome.quality.description: Separate raw lead volume from enquiries that are commercially relevant.
analyticsCrm.outcome.optimisation.title: More useful optimisation
analyticsCrm.outcome.optimisation.descri: Make campaign decisions using signals beyond clicks, CTR and platform conversion totals.
analyticsCrm.outcome.reporting.title: Stronger reporting
analyticsCrm.outcome.reporting.descripti: Give marketing and management a clearer view of what happens between acquisition and sales follow-up.
analyticsCrm.problems.title: When marketing and CRM tell different stories.
analyticsCrm.problems.item1: Ads report conversions, but sales cannot identify where leads came from.
analyticsCrm.problems.item2: UTM data disappears before the enquiry reaches CRM.
analyticsCrm.problems.item3: Several different source naming conventions are used.
analyticsCrm.problems.item4: Platform leads and website leads cannot be compared consistently.
analyticsCrm.problems.item5: Marketing reports lead volume while sales reports poor lead quality.
analyticsCrm.problems.item6: GA4 events exist but do not reflect meaningful commercial actions.
analyticsCrm.problems.item7: Campaign optimisation stops at the form submission.
analyticsCrm.problems.item8: CRM status changes never make it back into marketing analysis.
analyticsCrm.tools.title: Built around the systems you already use.
analyticsCrm.crm.title: A lead is more useful when its context travels with it.
analyticsCrm.crm.body1: When campaign information, enquiry details and qualification status live in separate systems, marketing performance becomes difficult to interpret.
analyticsCrm.crm.body2: DIAL helps structure the flow so useful source information reaches CRM, lead status can be analysed consistently, and marketing decisions can incorporate what happens after the initial enquiry.
analyticsCrm.attribution.title: Attribution without pretending the journey is simple.
analyticsCrm.attribution.body: Customer journeys rarely follow a single clean click-to-conversion path. The objective is not to manufacture perfect attribution, but to preserve useful source information, define consistent conversion events and build enough visibility to make better decisions.
analyticsCrm.reporting.title: Reports should explain decisions, not just activity.
analyticsCrm.reporting.body: Useful reporting connects campaign investment, website behaviour, enquiries and available lead-quality signals. The aim is to make it easier to understand what changed, why it matters and what should happen next.
